name: io.github.Servosity/dnsfilter-mcp
title: DNSFilter MCP
description: DNSFilter for MSPs: why a site is blocked, preview-first allows, unblock requests, agent drift.

environmentVariables.name: DNSFILTER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: DNSFilter API base URL (default https://api.dnsfilter.com).

environmentVariables.name: DNSFILTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: DNSFilter API token (bare token, no Bearer prefix), from Account Settings, API Tokens.

environmentVariables.name: DNSFILTER_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: override the User-Agent the CLI sends.

environmentVariables.name: DNSFILTER_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: set to 1 so the MCP server offers DNSFilter reads only, without secret-bearing reads.

environmentVariables.name: DNSFILTER_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token callers must present when the server runs with --transport http; not used by stdio.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Not enforced by this connector (no tenant-gated profiles); leave unset. It does not limit access.
